text:
Alex Ops: Heads up — we're 18 H100s short for the west-us cluster after the DOA replacements ate into the reserve. Need ETA from vendor on replacements and whether they require the 20% allocation deposit they mentioned last week. Impact: two burst decks will be out of service next week if we don't get top-up.

Maria HW: Confirming — the DOA units were under the RMA swap lane, we accepted returns. Vendor said some of the replacements come from a separate consolidated air pool, others via sea (ETA +4w). They asked if we can accept split shipments (10 air / rest sea) because of pallet constraints.

Jamie Procurement: I pinged vendor earlier: they want a deposit for the new allocation to hold manufacture slot. Quote attached in their email. If we pay deposit, lead time drops from 6–8w to 2–3w for the air portion. Can share PO mod if ops signs off.

Olivia Logistics: Split shipments mean two AWBs and two customs clearances. For EU/US shipments we can consolidate docs but local DC wants separate pallet manifests for the air box. Also vendor flagged possible HS code reclassification for refurbished replacements — could add duties. Need confirmation now if Redwood covers duties for the air top-up.

Alex Ops: Short answer from product: we need at least 8 H100s in west-us by next Tue to keep the canary pools running. Paying deposit is OK if procurement can get an invoice quickly. Any chance vendor will push only H100 PCIe 80GB not the 96GB stager? Firmware mismatch on recent replacements caused a rollback last month.

VendorBot: Vendor update: "Allocation Reserve request received. Deposit term: 20% net30. Air split possible: 10 units (expedite) / balance sea. Replacements flagged as new units, not refurbished; HS code: 8542.31.90. Expected air AWB: ETA 72h after payment confirmation. Sea ETA: 4–6 weeks. Firmware build: 2025.03 (confirmed)."

Maria HW: Re firmware — please request vendor to ship image-matched units or we accept firewalled staging to reflash before joining production. Last time hotpatching on a live node caused KV cache invalidations.

Ben Network: On the infra side, if the 8 units don't arrive we can temporarily shift some high-cost workloads to dedicated partners, but that will spike token cost and latency. We should calculate cost delta: estimated $0.45/token -> $0.78/token for burst. Also need to move east-us fallback routing for specific customers to avoid cross-region egress.

Jamie Procurement: I'll approve PO mod if Olivia can confirm incoterms and duties allocation. Olivia — can you accept vendor invoice and initiate payment today? I'll need the deposit invoice PDF for finance.

Olivia Logistics: I can process but we need vendor to split invoice lines by AWB and include HS code + weight per pallet. Also need carrier contact for the expedited air pickup. If they provide the AWB before EOD we can route to our broker and avoid a custom holdup.

Alex Ops: Action items: 1) Jamie to request deposit invoice and confirm payment terms. 2) Vendor to provide AWB and firmware batch. 3) Olivia to confirm duty responsibility and pre-alert broker. 4) Maria to confirm flashing plan for firmware mismatch. 5) Ben to publish routing change plan if top-up delayed.

Jamie Procurement: On it — sending vendor a PO mod request now with the clause: "Redwood to pay deposit; vendor to provide AWB and HS code before ship; vendor to absorb any duty discrepancies only if mis-declared." Will paste the PO text here when vendor replies.

VendorBot: Vendor reply: "Invoice generated: INV-778921. Deposit: 20% = $144,000. AWB placeholder for air: TBD-EXP-2134 (will update after payment). Sea BL: TBD-SEA-879. Can ship image-matched units on request; please provide serials to pin builds."

Olivia Logistics: I need the final invoice PDF and AWB to pre-clear. Also request vendor to mark 'sensitive electronic equipment' on airway bill to avoid pallet de-stuffing.

Alex Ops: Good. If deposit clears tonight, prioritize shipping air 10 -> west-us DC1 only. Maria — coordinate with on-call to keep canary pools on reduced capacity and Ben to implement routing. I'll post an update in #eng-runtime with outage window.

Maria HW: Noted. I'll schedule a maintenance window for reflash and keep rolling restarts to minimize KV cache thrash.

Ben Network: I'll draft the routing change and cost table. If we need to flip to partner hosting, tag me in the A/B test plan.

Jamie Procurement: Deposit paid — payment ref 0xA7F3 (will attach remittance). Vendor replied with air AWB after payment: AWB-EX213499. ETA to carrier scan: 19:00 PST.

VendorBot: Air AWB scanned: AWB-EX213499. Pickup ETA confirmed. Sea BL to follow.

Olivia Logistics: Broker pre-alert sent, customs docs prepared. If carrier scans before 19:30 we clear air overnight and should have units at DC by Tue morning.

Alex Ops: Thanks everyone — I'll update #eng-runtime and follow up if anything changes. :thumbsup:
